title: [Tool/Database] PGMZ - A searchable database of over 1,000 Japanese RPG Maker MZ plugins

posts.author: munokura
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I'm excited to share a new resource for all RPG Maker MZ developers: PGMZ - Plugin Library for MZ.
PGMZ is a searchable database of over 1,000 plugins for RPG Maker MZ, with a special focus on making it easy to find and use high-quality plugins from Japanese creators. Many excellent plugins are developed in Japan, but they are often difficult for non-Japanese speakers to discover. Our goal is to bridge that gap and bring these great resources to a wider audience.
What you can find on PGMZ:
Extensive Database: Search through more than 1,000 plugins.
Easy Discovery: Quickly find the exact plugin you need with our search filters.
English-Friendly: All plugin descriptions and information are translated into English, so you can easily understand what each plugin does and how to use it.
Visit PGMZ here:
About this site - PGMZ - The Community-Driven Plugin Library for RPG Maker MZ
This is the ultimate global database for RPG Maker MZ plugins. Our goal is to create a comprehensive and easy-to-use resource for all developers and creators, and to centralize the best plugins from across the globe, all with English-searchable information. PGMZ is a community-driven platform...
en.plugin-mz.fungamemake.com
This is an ongoing project, and we're constantly adding new plugins and improving the site. We'd love to hear your feedback on the site and any features you'd like to see.
Thank you,
The PGMZ Team
---
**[UPDATE]**
Thank you all for the great feedback and for your kind words!
Some of you have asked if PGMZ is only for Japanese plugins. I'd like to clarify that our goal is to build a global database for ALL RPG Maker MZ plugins, and we welcome submissions from creators worldwide.
Our initial focus was on Japanese plugins to bridge the language gap, but we are a community-driven library for everyone.
If you have a plugin you'd like to share, please feel free to submit it on the site. Thank you for your support!

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Thank you making an English version of the site! I've used that site a lot with my browser translating it from Japanese before, but this should streamline the process a good bit, haha.
As you say, there's a lot of really great plugins from the Japanese RPG Maker that many in the English community might have missed due to the language barrier, and this should help a lot.

posts.author: munokura
posts.body:
Currently, we have included plugins by Triacontan that do not have English help.
If there is a high demand, we plan to continue adding OSS plugins from other authors.
It seems that Japanese users also find it difficult to find plugins in English, so we would appreciate it if you could register information about your plugins.

posts.body:
ShadowDragon said:
there was another, but probably stopped adding.
can you find plugins by names/key/author or part of it?
Click to expand...
Hello!
Thank you for your question.
You can indeed find plugins by name, author, or a key part of the name. Just use the search bar at the top of the site.
The database is not yet complete. New plugins are constantly being added by both myself and other users. Our goal is to make PGMZ a comprehensive community resource for finding plugins.
I hope you find what you're looking for!
